nodes.summary: Rippling offers a comprehensive suite of business management solutions, including HR, payroll, IT, and expense management. It enables businesses to automate and streamline their operations, from employee data management and compensation to device security and company spending. The platform is designed to be tailored to the needs of businesses of all sizes and across various industries.

nodes.name: HR Management
nodes.description: Manages employee data, automates HR compliance, and provides tools for recruitment, performance management, and learning management.

nodes.name: Payroll Services
nodes.description: Allows businesses to pay employees and contractors globally, with features to mitigate contractor risk and manage payroll taxes.

nodes.name: IT Management
nodes.description: Provides tools for identity and access management, device management, and user authentication, with a focus on security and efficiency.

nodes.name: Expense Management
nodes.description: Offers granular control over company spending, with features for enforcing expense policies, controlling card spend, and managing bills.

nodes.name: Workflow Automation
nodes.description: Enables businesses to trigger advanced workflows using any data, enforce company rules automatically, and integrate with third-party apps.

nodes.name: Global Operations
nodes.description: Facilitates global operations with features for hiring globally, managing global HR, and saving on global spending.
